[size=5][u][color=#f1c232][b]Lay Pipe All Over Your Farm![/b][/color][/u][/size]

[size=2]Confused with why wooden paths connect machines and chests in Automate? Clear up that brain-fog and add in pipes! Replaces the "Wood Path" with a pipe!

Now you can connect your machines and chests with a pipe to draw materials from your [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Junimo_Hut]Junimo Huts[/url] or your [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Auto-Grabber]Auto-Grabbers[/url] to your chests or your processing machines like [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Mayonnaise_Machine]Mayonnaise Machines[/url] or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Oil_Maker]Oil Makers[/url]! Finally no more paths as pipes, now you can use pipes as pipes![/size]

[size=2][b][color=#f1c232] ﻿---[/color][/b] Replaces the "Wood Path" craftable with a pipe

[b][color=#f1c232] ﻿---[/color][/b] Replaces the "Wood Path" object with a pipe

[b][color=#f1c232] ﻿---[/color][/b] Replaces the "Wood Path" object description
[/size]

[size=5][u][color=#f1c232][b]Config Options[/b][/color][/u][/size]
Use GMCM (or the [CP] Laying Pipe - An Automate Companion / [CP-A] Laying Pipe / config.json) to edit the following config options...

[color=#f1c232]Wood Path (Pipe R) Ends[/color]
﻿﻿Animated = Moves according to the speed below
﻿Static = Does not animate
[color=#f1c232]Wood Path (Pipe R) Middles[/color]
﻿ ﻿Animated = Moves according to the speed below
﻿Static = Does not animate
[color=#f1c232]Crystal Path (Pipe L) Ends[/color]
﻿﻿Animated = Moves according to the speed below
﻿Static = Does not animate
[color=#f1c232]Crystal Path (Pipe L) Middles[/color]
﻿Animated = Moves according to the speed below
﻿Static = Does not animate
[color=#f1c232]Wood Path (Pipe R)[/color]
﻿﻿Slow = 9 60ths of a second between frames
﻿Medium = 15 60ths of a second between frames
﻿Fast = 21 60ths of a second between frames
[color=#f1c232]Crystal Path (Pipe L)[/color]
﻿Slow = 9 60ths of a second between frames
﻿Medium = 15 60ths of a second between frames
﻿Fast = 21 60ths of a second between frames

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Windows Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]here on the wiki[/url]﻿ if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on Windows)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder into your "SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods \ Laying Pipe - An Automate Companion"[/size]

[color=#f1c232]6) [/color][size=2]Go to your mods folder and open up the "Automate" mod folder, open up the "config.json" in any text editor and add "Wood Path" and "Crystal Path" to the "ConnectorNames" section of the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] config.json[/size]
[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/13739/13739-1662952154-2092910589.png[/img]

[b][color=#f1c232]7)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]

[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]
[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]MacOS Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1) [/b][/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Mac]here on the wiki﻿[/url] if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on MacOS)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder into your "Library \ Application Support \ Steam \ SteamApps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Contents \ MacOS \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"Library \ Application Support \ Steam \ SteamApps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Contents \ MacOS \ Mods \ Laying Pipe - An Automate Companion"[/size]

[color=#f1c232]6) [/color][size=2]Go to your mods folder and open up the "Automate" mod folder, open up the "config.json" in any text editor and add "Wood Path" and "Crystal Path" to the "ConnectorNames" section of the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] config.json[/size]
[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/13739/13739-1662952154-2092910589.png[/img]

[b][color=#f1c232]7)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]
